primary_antecedent.scope: Primary background for Airy multipliers and propagation. The full weighted commutator, localized membership argument and general scalar-principal receiving proof are independently supplied in this lesson.

All three Airy kernel pieces retain their exact phases. Ratio cancellation controls the boundary layer, and all normal derivatives cost only finite initial order.

The actual value trace belongs microlocally to the stable-weight space by the exact Airy multiplier bound and ordinary weighted localization. This is the local strict-diffractive result, not a global complementary decomposition.
